title: Quietly dried Tunisian Saskatoon berries Wrap
description: A kid-friendly Tunisian dish featuring dehydrated Saskatoon berries wrapped in ti leaves, perfect for a light and healthy snack
instructions: Preheat the oven to 150 degrees Fahrenheit to dehydrate the Saskatoon berries.
Rinse the Saskatoon berries and remove any stems or debris.
Spread the Saskatoon berries on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Dehydrate the Saskatoon berries in the oven for 3 hours, or until they are dry and slightly chewy.
While the berries are dehydrating, prepare the ti leaves by washing them in cold water and patting them dry with a paper towel.
In a small bowl, mix together the coconut oil, honey, lemon juice, and salt.
Once the berries are dry, brush the ti leaves with the coconut oil mixture and place a few dried berries in the center of each leaf.
Sprinkle a small amount of almond flour over the berries to help hold them in place.
Fold the ti leaves over the berries to form a wrap and serve immediately.
